# Timothy and His Grandmother (2 Timothy 1:5)

## Emotional Focus
Learning about Jesus from family who love Him.

## Key KJV
“When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice.” (2 Timothy 1:5)

## Gentle Retelling
Young Timothy learned to love God from his grandmother Lois and mother Eunice. Their quiet faith helped him grow up strong in Jesus.

## Coloring Prompt
Young Timothy sitting happily between his grandmother and mother reading from a scroll.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Family who love Jesus help us love Him too.”
